Ⓝ[Habit]ual,Ⓒa.ⒹaByAsaja, nitya, satata, anuSIlita, AByAsika-vyAvahArika-svABAvika (kI f.); ‘a h(abitual) drunkard’ nityapAnAsaktaH; ‘a h(abitual) worker’ kriyAvAn, karmasu udyataH kArmaH, karmaSIlaH.
Ⓝ[Habit]ually,Ⓒadv.ⒹnityaM, satataM, yaTAByAsaM, yaTArIti, yaTAvyava-hAraM.
